turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyText:
Yes, Fashion Nova ships internationally.

Customs fees and duties depend on your destination country and local customs rules. If your package is held at customs, you may be asked to provide an invoice or proof of purchase (your Fashion Nova order confirmation email usually works), and sometimes ID verification.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyText:
For Standard Shipping in the US, delivery is estimated at **3–7 business days**.

Standard domestic and international orders can also take **up to 4 business days to process** before they ship (business days don’t include weekends or US holidays). For the full breakdown by method and country, see [shipping options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: What's your return and refund policy?
turns.replyText:
Items must be **unworn, unused, in original/new condition with tags attached**, and **returned within 30 days of delivery** to be eligible.

Approved returns are refunded as **store credit via a Fashion Nova e-gift card (USD)**. Fashion Nova generally does not offer direct exchanges. Full details are here: [Refunds, Credits, and Exchanges](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/help-center/refunds-credits-and-exchanges).
